arxiv-2202-10170.title: Entropy of Generating Series for Nonlinear Input-Output Systems and Their Interconnections This paper is a contribution to the Special Issue on Non-Commutative Algebra, Probability and Analysis in Action. The full collection is available at https://www.emis.de/journals/SIGMA/non-commutative-probabil
arxiv-2202-10170.creator: W. Steven GRAY
arxiv-2202-10170.description: Abstract This paper has two main objectives. The first is to introduce a notion of entropy that is well suited for the analysis of nonlinear input-output systems that have a Chen–Fliess series representation. The latter is defined in terms of its generating series over a noncommutative alphabet.

arxiv-2206-10611.title: Neural Activation Patterns (NAPs): Visual Explainability of Learned Concepts
arxiv-2206-10611.creator: Alex Bäuerle, Daniel Jönsson, and Timo Ropinski
arxiv-2206-10611.description: Abstract A key to deciphering the inner workings of neural networks is understanding what a model has learned. Promising methods for discovering learned features are based on analyzing activation values, whereby current techniques focus on analyzing high activation values to reveal interesting features on a neuron level. However, analyzing high activation values limits layer-level concept discovery.

arxiv-2212-04323.title: University of Minho
arxiv-2212-04323.description: Abstract Abstract Ansätze for Noisy Variational Quantum Eigensolvers Simulating quantum mechanical systems is one of the main applications envisioned for quantum computers. In contrast with the first algorithms created for this purpose, that were devised to be implemented in a fault-tolerant quantum computer, the VQE aims to adjust to the constraints of NISQ devices.

arxiv-2301-12509.title: Constraining Barrow entropy-based Cosmology with power-law inflation
arxiv-2301-12509.creator: G. G. Luciano
arxiv-2301-12509.description: Abstract We study the inflationary era of the Universe in a modified cosmological scenario based on the gravity-thermodynamics conjecture with Barrow entropy instead of the usual Bekenstein-Hawking one. The former arises from the effort to account for quantum gravitational effects on the horizon surface of black holes and, in a broader sense, of the Universe.

arxiv-2311-15781.title: Increasing Coverage and Precision of Textual Information in Multilingual Knowledge Graphs
arxiv-2311-15781.creator: Simone Conia, Min Li, Daniel Lee, Umar Farooq Minhas, Ihab Ilyas, Yunyao Li
arxiv-2311-15781.description: Abstract Recent work in Natural Language Processing and Computer Vision has been using textual information – e.g., entity names and descriptions – available in knowledge graphs to ground neural models to high-quality structured data. However, when it comes to non-English languages, the quantity and quality of textual information are comparatively scarce.

arxiv-2405-06679.title: Complex Analytic Structure of Stationary Flows of an Ideal Incompressible Fluid
arxiv-2405-06679.creator: Aleksander Danielski, Alexander Shnirelman
arxiv-2405-06679.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Aleksander Danielski, Alexander Shnirelman. In this article we introduce the structure of an analytic Banach manifold in the set of stationary flows without stagnation points of the ideal incompressible fluid in a periodic 2-d channel bounded by the curves y = f ⁡ ( x ) y=f(x) and y = g ⁡ ( x ) y=g(x) where f , g f,g are periodic analytic functions.

arxiv-2410-19408.title: Minimal 𝑺 ​ 𝑶 ​ ( 𝟏𝟎 ) \bm{SO(10)} ante portas : the importance of being effective
arxiv-2410-19408.creator: Anca Preda 1 , Goran Senjanović 2,3 and Michael Zantedeschi 4,5
arxiv-2410-19408.description: Abstract The minimal S ​ O ​ ( 10 ) SO(10) grand unified theory, augmented by higher-dimensional operators, is based on the following Higgs representations: adjoint 45 H 45_{\rm H} , spinor 16 H 16_{\rm H} and complex vector 10 H 10_{\rm H} .

arxiv-2412-14562.title: Ultraviolet Completion of a Two-loop Neutrino Mass Model
arxiv-2412-14562.creator: K.S. Babu, Shaikh Saad
arxiv-2412-14562.description: Abstract The Zee-Babu model is an economical framework for neutrino mass generation as two-loop quantum corrections. In this work, we present a UV completion of this model by embedding it into an S ​ U ​ ( 5 ) SU(5) unified framework.

arxiv-2501-06986.title: LEO: Boosting Mixture of Vision Encoders for Multimodal Large Language Models
arxiv-2501-06986.creator: Mozhgan Nasr Azadani, James Riddell, Sean Sedwards, Krzysztof Czarnecki
arxiv-2501-06986.description: Abstract Enhanced visual understanding serves as a cornerstone for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Recent hybrid MLLMs incorporate a mixture of vision experts to address the limitations of using a single vision encoder and excessively long visual tokens. Despite the progress of these MLLMs, a research gap remains in effectively integrating diverse vision encoders.

arxiv-2509-19357.title: The Inverse Function Fallacy: On Sign Determination and Forgotten Fundamentals
arxiv-2509-19357.creator: Meliksah Yorulmazlar
arxiv-2509-19357.description: Abstract Although inverse functions are introduced early in algebra, many students remain unaware that an inverse expression may legitimately involve a negative root. Instead, they default to assuming a positive root, overlooking the role of domain restrictions in determining the correct solution.

arxiv-2602-03989.title: A gas-phase “top-down” chemical link between aldehydes and alcohols
arxiv-2602-03989.creator: Christopher N. Shingledecker 1,∗ , German Molpeceres 2 , A. Mackenzie Flowers 3 , Deaton Warren 1 , Emma Stanley 1 , and Anthony Remijan 4
arxiv-2602-03989.description: Abstract 1 Introduction Alcohols and aldehydes represent two key classes of interstellar complex organic molecules (COMs). This work seeks to better understand their possible chemical connections, with a focus on such molecules in the sources of the star-forming region Sgr B2 (N).

On the retreat from Kabul of General Elphinstone’s army in 1842, a hill near Gandamak was the scene of the massacre of the last survivors of the force, twenty officers and forty-five British soldiers. It is also notable for the treaty of Gandamak, which was signed here in 1879 with Yakub Khan.

doe-osti-3409786-digital-twin-visualizin.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. The energy systems are generating data at a scale and complexity that increasingly outpaces our ability to analyze it. pmc-10742644.creator: Tian Li, Xinwei Wang, Chunyan Li, Qingquan Fu, Xuewei Shi, Bin Wang
pmc-10742644.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Acetobacter pasteurianus is always used to brew vinegar because of its ability of producing and tolerating a high concentration of acetic acid. During vinegar fermentation, initial acetic acid contributes to acetic acid accumulation, which varies with initial concentrations.

pmc-10917385.title: Insight in obsessive-compulsive disorder: conception, clinical characteristics, neuroimaging, and treatment
pmc-10917385.creator: Yueqi Huang, Yazhu Weng, Lan Lan, Cheng Zhu, Ting Shen, Wenxin Tang, Hsin-Yi Lai
pmc-10917385.description: Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) is a chronic disabling disease with often unsatisfactory therapeutic outcomes. The fifth edition of the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM-5) has broadened the diagnostic criteria for OCD, acknowledging that some OCD patients may lack insight into their symptoms.

pmc-11504425.title: Evaluation of Vulnerabilities for the Spread of Carbapenem Resistant Organisms at Five Hospitals in India
pmc-11504425.creator: Susan Fallon, Umang Agrawal, Shaoli Basu, Valeria Fabre, Sarah Fisseha, Johns Hopkins Hospital, Arjunlal Kakrani, Rajesh Karyakarte, Mahadevan Kumar, Abhijeet Mane, Vidya Mave, Yatin Mehta, SHAHZAD MIRZA, Akaash Patel, Bharat Randive, Prachala Rathod, Matthew Robinson, Camilla Rodrigues, Smita Sarma
pmc-11504425.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: The 2022 WHO global survey on infection prevention and control (IPC) exposes significant gaps in IPC in the WHO Southeast Asia region. A better understanding of IPC vulnerabilities will inform improvement initiatives. We describe an evaluation of IPC practices known to prevent and contain carbapenem-resistant organisms (CROs) at hospitals participating in the United States Centers for Disease Control Global Action in Healthcare Network –Antimicrobial Resistance in India. Prior hospital evaluations suggest resistance to carbapenems among gram-negative isolates is up to 45%.

pmc-11543385.title: Impact of Siponimod on Clinical and Radiological Parameters of Secondary Progressive Multiple Sclerosis: A Real-World Prospective Study
pmc-11543385.creator: Konstantina Stavrogianni, Dimitrios K. Kitsos, Vasileios Giannopapas, Maria-Ioanna Stefanou, Niki Christouli, Vassiliki Smyrni, Athanasios K. Chasiotis, Alexandra Akrivaki, Evangelia Dimitriadou, Maria Chondrogianni, Georgios Tsivgoulis, Sotirios Giannopoulos
pmc-11543385.description: Background and PurposeSecondary progressive multiple sclerosis (SPMS) presents with a challenging clinical phenotype, and siponimod has a potential to treat the active clinical phenotype of this disease. This single-center longitudinal study aimed to determine the therapeutic effects of siponimod in patients with active SPMS over 12 months.

pmc-12617867.title: Deciphering CO2 flux and fluorescent DOM origins in the carbon cycle of Kaptai Lake
pmc-12617867.creator: Osman Miah, Rhidi Barma, Md. Anamul Hassan, Mashura Shammi, Shafi M. Tareq
pmc-12617867.description: This study aimed to assess the current water quality, identify the sources of fluorescent dissolved organic matter (fDOM), and quantify the CO2 flux from Kaptai Lake surface water. A water quality multiparameter analyzer, a membrane-enclosed pCO2 sensor, and a weather monitoring device were deployed to continuously record data over 48 hours to observe daily and spatial shifts.

pmc-13082637.title: Alkyl gallates disrupt Trypanosoma brucei lipid droplets
pmc-13082637.creator: Cynthia Mmalebna Amisigo, Gloria Amegatcher, Jack D. Sunter, Theresa Manful Gwira
pmc-13082637.description: African trypanosomiasis is a deadly disease that affects humans and animals, with treatment hindered by drug toxicity and resistance, highlighting the need for alternative therapies. Alkyl gallates, which are plant-derived phenolipids used in the food, cosmetics, and pharmaceutical industries, have been shown to have potent anti-microbial activity; however, their mechanism of action is still unclear.

pmc-13191928.title: Machine learning prediction of antibiotic resistance in Gram-negative pneumonia: a clinical-genomic integrated model
pmc-13191928.creator: Jing Guan, Zhaoming Chen, Haoru Wang, Weilong Li, Feng Ye, Shaoqiang Li
pmc-13191928.description: ObjectiveTo explore the application value of a multi-omics fusion model based on clinical indicators and genomic features in the prediction of antibiotic resistance in Gram-negative bacterial pneumonia, screen key biomarkers influencing resistance, construct and validate an efficient prediction model, and provide a basis for the precise clinical use of antibiotics.

pmc-13381462.title: Amino acid-based formula with synbiotics for cow's milk protein allergy: a real-world study of symptom evolution and quality-of-life outcomes
pmc-13381462.creator: Sebastián Ramiro Soria, Pablo Malagrino, Estefanía Sacconi, Graciela Martin, Nicolás Rovati, Verónica Plante, Florencia Grisel Ursino, María Florencia Biasoli, Natalia Alejandra Petriz, Paula Micone, Eugenia Maciero, Norberto Giglio
pmc-13381462.description: BackgroundCow's milk protein allergy (CMPA) is a common early-life food allergy. Evidence from routine care settings may complement randomized trials by describing symptom trajectories in heterogeneous populations.ObjectiveThis study aimed to describe changes in symptom scores and caregiver-reported outcomes over 28 days following initiation of an amino acid-based formula containing synbiotics in infants with suspected or confirmed CMPA in routine practice.

pmc-13481100.title: Effective Control of Synchronous Male Breast and Prostate Cancer with Androgen Deprivation Therapy: A Case Report
pmc-13481100.creator: Megumi Furukawa, Naomi Gondo, Reiko Mitsueda, Akiko Arimura, Yoshitaka Fujiki, Junko Kawano, Shuichi Kanemitsu, Megumi Teraoka, Yasuyo Ohi, Yoshiaki Rai, Yoshiaki Sagara, Yasuaki Sagara, Shinji Ohno
pmc-13481100.description: INTRODUCTIONMale breast cancer (BC) is a rare disease, accounting for less than 1% of all BCs, and its synchronous occurrence with prostate cancer (PC) is exceedingly rare. Male BC is generally managed according to treatment strategies established for female BC; however, the role of androgen receptor (AR) signaling and androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) in male BC remains unclear.

pmc-13521336.title: Metabolic disorders and osteoarthritis: novel insights into pathological mechanisms and therapeutic strategies
pmc-13521336.creator: Chunchun Xue, Wenyun Kui, Xiaofeng Li, Lingxing Li, Lilong Song, Dong Mao, John R Speakman, Ling Qin, Liping Tong, Di Chen
pmc-13521336.description: Metabolic disorders and osteoarthritis (OA) are chronic noncommunicable diseases with high global prevalence. Accumulating evidence underscores a strong association between metabolic illnesses and the onset and progression of the OA. This review systematically summarizes the current insights and mechanisms between metabolic disorders (obesity, hyperglycemia, dyslipidemia, hypertension, and gut microbiota dysbiosis) and OA from both epidemiology and molecular biology perspectives.

pmc-13588236.title: Hydrogen sulfide‐mediated persulfidation of ERF106 controls pear fruit aroma biosynthesis via disrupting the ERF106‐MYB21‐FAD8 complex
pmc-13588236.creator: Zhuoyan Xu, Kangdi Hu, Longfei Yan, Shuwei Wei, Weisheng Zhao, Huihui Song, Gaifang Yao, Hua Zhang
pmc-13588236.description: SUMMARYHydrogen sulfide (H2S) and its mediated protein persulfidation regulate fruit ripening. Fruit aroma, a key quality trait formed during ripening, largely determines consumer preferences. However, the mechanism by which H2S modulates aroma biosynthesis in pear remains unclear. This study reveals that H2S inhibited aroma biosynthesis in ‘Nanguo’ pear and downregulated the fatty acid desaturase gene PuFAD8.
